text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear opening claim that driverless cars are \"not a necessity\" and \"pose a threat\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"Paragraphs on sensors, safety, and the limitations of \"not all the way driverless\"","quality":"argument development","description":"It supports its position with multiple reasons and explanations instead of mostly opinion."},{"evidence":"“However, some people might argue…” followed by a response","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges an opposing view and then answers it rather than ignoring it."},{"evidence":"Body paragraph with examples like the drunk driver and baby at the hospital","quality":"specific illustration","description":"It uses concrete scenarios to make its claims more vivid and persuasive."},{"evidence":"Introduction, body, and conclusion are all present","quality":"essay organization","description":"It has a more complete argumentative structure with a clear beginning, middle, and end."}]}
